description: The Marketing Engineer's runtime and write boundary (Guardrails G1, G2, G8), chosen in US-ME02. The launcher (src/bin/gr0wthlab) turns this file into a Codex permission profile and command-line flags, ignoring the Founder's own Codex configuration and rules. The launcher's own records live in ledger/, which the run reads with the rest of the repository and never writes. Why Codex, and the refused-write evidence: docs/spikes/us-me02-runtime-boundary.md.

filesystem.deny_why: Codex's :minimal system grant also makes /tmp and /var/tmp writable; denying them keeps every write inside the writable areas.

codex.reasoning_effort_why: The effort the weekly agent reasons with. The launcher passes it to Codex as model_reasoning_effort, for the agent alone: the preflight runs no model. Codex's default for this model is medium, and at medium the agent ended its one session after one to four minutes whatever was left on its list: in the investigation of 2026-10-11, five of five fresh runs on main left work undone, 37 of 44 Draft claims named no code, and the two runs that said Review: complete had done the least. At high, five of five runs finished the review, each found all four stale facts checked by hand, and 35 of 44 claims named code, at about 0.08 dollars and 4.5 to 15 minutes of agent time a run against about 0.02 dollars and 1.6 to 3.7 minutes. A finish checklist in the task definition did not help, nor did splitting the work into separate sessions at medium. The Founder approved high on 2026-10-11. FINAL_RUNS_SENTENCE The samples are small, so judge whether the setting keeps working by what the launcher counts of each session, which the run report shows beside the agent's own Review line (work_counts in config/run.json), never by that line alone. The agent's time limit is agent.time_limit_seconds in config/run.json, whose note says how these run times sit against it. Change the effort only here, through a reviewed change followed by a fresh boundary check, since it changes the Codex command every run starts with. The launcher refuses any value but low, medium, high, xhigh, and max, the efforts Codex's model catalog lists for this model: Codex passes any other text on, and the model's service refuses it only once the agent has started.

machine_overrides.GR0WTHLAB_CODEX_BIN: Absolute path of the codex executable; default: codex on the launcher's PATH.
machine_overrides.GR0WTHLAB_MANDU_DIR, GR0WTHLAB_REPTODAY_: Read-only checkout locations, as config/products.json describes.
